summary_markdown:
The session involved coordinating the ordering of specific hardware components. Initially, a request was made to order one 2D Lidar (RPLidar S1) and one Jetson 4GB for an individual.

Later, a question regarding the continuous operational capability and expected lifespan of the RPLidar S1 when queried from Slamtech was confirmed as relevant.
decisions: Order one 2D Lidar (RPLidar S1) and one Jetson 4GB.
action_items: Someone to send the query about the RPLidar S1's continuous operation capability and lifespan to Slamtech.
